message: More on this topic, if you could. What comprises rhetoric? Does it include advertising? Marketing? Branding? Spectacle? What of the counter-rhtorics of the oppressed? Uncle Remus, parables, fairytales, rap? I note that your final move is to invoke "questions" rather than "answers." Again, isn't that to position rhetoric with knowledge? Wouldn't the drift of your discourse be towards upsetting power relations, destabliizing them, rather than just posing questions? I am sure that insubordination will go over well next year in the Chain of Command.
